Kassadin

the Void Walker

Kassadin is a void walker who's weak early and becomes one of the scariest champions in the game late. His ultimate, Riftwalk, is a short teleport with a tiny cooldown at high levels. Survive the early game, and you'll blink onto enemy carries again and again.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

When to pick Kassadin

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Better as a counter-pick: AD assassins crush his early game.

Pick into

  • Mage-heavy teams, since his passive reduces magic damage
  • Mages like Orianna and Akali
  • Slow, long games where he reaches level 16
  • Channeling ultimates he can interrupt with Null Sphere

Avoid into

  • AD assassins like Zed and Talon
  • Early lane bullies like Pantheon
  • Teams that want to end the game fast

Great teammates

OrnnA tank frontline keeps the game long and safe for Kassadin.
LuluLulu keeps Kassadin alive while he dives.
MalphiteMalphite's engage gives Kassadin time to blink in.

Your team needs: A team that can survive the early game and play for the late game.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Insane late-game scaling: at level 16, Riftwalk can be cast every few seconds
  • Takes less magic damage, so he's great against mage-heavy teams
  • Null Sphere interrupts channels and shields against magic damage
  • Very hard to catch once he has his ultimate

Weaknesses

  • One of the weakest early games: melee, short range, easy to bully
  • Physical damage champions, especially AD assassins, beat him in lane
  • Needs farm and time; if the game ends fast he can't do much
  • Low impact before level 6 and his first items

Power spikes

  • Level 6: Riftwalk gives you mobility and roam potential
  • First item (Rod of Ages): health, mana and sustain to survive the hard early game
  • Two items (Archangel's Staff): huge mana scaling; it upgrades into Seraph's Embrace once fully stacked
  • Level 11: Riftwalk cooldown drops a lot
  • Three items (Malignance) and level 16: Riftwalk every couple of seconds, you're the strongest champion on the map

Top tips

  • Survive the early game; Kassadin's power comes later
  • Use empowered Nether Blade to last-hit and restore mana
  • Null Sphere cancels channels: watch for enemy ultimates
  • Riftwalk stacks cost more mana, so plan your chains
  • Farm side lanes in the mid game to reach level 16 faster
  • Ward to spot AD assassins coming for you
